subject: Pivota Labs — urgent exec escalation: throughput/errors & credit proposal
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@pivota.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@pivota.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High error/latency this morning — need executive attention

Alex —

We hit a significant regression this morning on our production traffic. Between 06:40 and 08:10 PDT we observed a ~40% throughput drop and a spike to 6.5% 5xx errors across our API surface. This impacted a subset of heavy users and caused a cascade of retries in our ingestion pipeline. Our observability team has attached a short error log extract (service_logs_0914.zip) — you should see the surge around 06:45.

We need:
- An immediate remediation plan (what actions Redwood will take in the next 24 hours)
- A preliminary estimate of commercial remediation (credits/refund) and how you’re calculating it against our committed usage
- Executive availability for a call today or tomorrow (Tom and Claudia will join)

We’ve already paused some high-volume jobs on our side, but this incident materially impacted customer SLAs. Please treat as P1.

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Director of Platform Engineering
Pivota Labs

Attachment: service_logs_0914.zip (log extract, 2.1MB)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@pivota.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error/latency this morning — need executive attention

Sara —

I’m really sorry to hear about the hit this morning. We’ve marked this P1 and I’ve looped in Dev and Rishi for immediate investigation. High level next steps from our side:
1) Dev will run a focused triage on the runtime nodes that served Pivota during the window and surface a mitigation within 2 hours.
2) Rishi will pull the exact token/throughput counts for the window to start a commercial impact calc.
3) I’ll coordinate an executive sync — Alex (me) + Marissa (commercial) will be available for an exec call later today or tomorrow morning.

Can you confirm the list of affected workloads and whether the customer-facing SLA impacted is the real-time inference endpoint (inference-v1)? Also please share the full usage CSV if you can (pivota_usage_summary_sep.pdf is helpful).

I’ll follow up with an initial remediation note within 90 minutes.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

Attachment referenced: pivota_usage_summary_sep.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: High error/latency this morning — initial triage findings

Quick summary from triage:
- Root pattern: transient KV cache thrash on the serving tier causing tail latency amplification under a specific client sequence length distribution.
- Impact window: 06:38 — 08:07 PDT (matches Sara's logs).
- Error mode: 5xx during heavy batch scheduling; queue timeouts for long-running requests.

Immediate mitigations enacted (11:15):
- Bumped the client-level concurrent request cap for Pivota’s pool to limit queue depth.
- Activated a fallback routing to a compatible, slightly lower-capacity model shard to preserve throughput for critical paths.
- Began warm-up of an additional dedicated GPU pool to absorb load.

Next actions (24 hrs):
- Full trace capture and replay to reproduce with Pivota’s traffic profile.
- Post-mortem write-up and remediation proposal (including config changes) by EOD tomorrow.

I’ve zipped the raw traces and included service_logs_0914.zip for your review. Short-term we recommend Pivota reduce burst windows while we finalize a patch to the scheduling heuristics.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior SRE — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: service_logs_0914.zip (raw traces + extract)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@pivota.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Claudia Espinoza <claudia.espinoza@pivota.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: High error/latency this morning — commercial remediation estimate

Sara / Tom / Claudia —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled usage. Preliminary commercial position:
- We calculate credit against the impacted window usage relative to forecasted committed usage. Based on initial logs, we estimate ~12 days of equivalent daily usage lost across the impacted customers in that window (we’ll convert this to a dollar credit).
- As a starting point we’re proposing a 20% credit on consumed inference units during the impacted window, subject to verification of the exact token counts and any overlapping protective measures taken on Pivota’s side.

To proceed we need:
1) Final usage CSV for Sep 1–17 (to validate baseline).
2) A short confirmation whether you accept a proportional credit calculation vs. a fixed MRR offset.
3) Confirmation if you want the credit applied to the next invoice or as a one-time refund.

I’ve attached a draft worksheet (proposed_credit_calc.xlsx) with the preliminary numbers. We’re open to negotiation — if the impact is broader than the window we will re-evaluate.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@pivota.com>, Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@pivota.com>, Claudia Espinoza <claudia.espinoza@pivota.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation & credit path — request for exec call

Team —

Following the technical findings and Marissa’s commercial calc, here’s a consolidated proposal:
1) Immediate: Redwood will finalize a scheduling patch and deploy a configuration change to prevent KV thrash within 48 hours. We’ll also keep the fallback routing active for the next 7 days while we validate stability.
2) Commercial: A 20% credit on inference consumption for the impacted window (we estimate $24,800 based on current numbers). We can apply as a credit on your next invoice or process as a one-time refund — please indicate preference.
3) Contractual: We propose a one-paragraph addendum to the SLA that clarifies rollback behavior for model shard fallback and an agreed escalation path; we can route this via DocuSign for approval.

Proposed next step: executive call Friday 09/17 at 11:00 AM PDT to align on the credit and the amendment. I’ve included a DocuSign link to the addendum for quick review: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=ABC-123-PIVOTA

If Pivota prefers a higher percentage, we’d like to understand the downstream revenue impact (customers lost, credits issued by Pivota) so we can model a joint remediation package (credit + free dedicated burst capacity for 30 days).

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@pivota.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@pivota.com>, Claudia Espinoza <claudia.espinoza@pivota.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation & credit path — request for exec call

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick response and the concrete plan. We appreciate the patch timeline. On the commercial side the 20% credit is a start but it underestimates the downstream operational costs we incurred (customer support credits, manual retry work, and a channel partner SLA payout). Given that, we’re asking Redwood to consider a 35% credit on the impacted window and a 30-day window of free dedicated burst capacity while you validate the fix.

We will join the 11:00 AM PDT call and expect executive-level ownership from Redwood (VP or above). Please include Marissa and Alex on the invite. Claudia will review the proposed addendum with legal and bring suggested language.

—Tom Lewis
VP Engineering
Pivota Labs

P.S. Claudia, can you share preferred time for 1:1 with Redwood legal after the call?
